problem.title: MULLS KITTI Odom seq 09 full: MULLS-LO with and without the elevation correction
problem.question: Does the MULLS-LO reimplementation (--mulls-lo, KITTI urban profile) reproduce the official MULLS code and the paper's Table II MULLS-LO values?

variants.label: MULLS-LO (KITTI urban profile) on raw scans
variants.intent: Ground filter, PCA pillar/facade classification and multi-metric linear least-squares ICP as in the paper's KITTI profile (papers/mulls/README.md).
variants.note: MULLS-LO (KITTI urban profile); anchor matches the first GT pose. 0 registrations stopped early (too few pairs or an implausible step).
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: MULLS-LO + 0.195 deg vertical-angle correction
variants.intent: Same pipeline with the profile's 0.195 deg HDL-64E vertical-angle calibration, as the official MULLS KITTI configuration.
variants.note: MULLS-LO (KITTI urban profile); anchor matches the first GT pose. 0 registrations stopped early (too few pairs or an implausible step).
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
